# Story 20.1: Red-phase tests for shared --dms-* token source and dead-class removal

Status: ready-for-dev

## Story

As a developer,
I want red-phase tests asserting Tailwind's `theme.extend` consumes the `--dms-*` tokens as its single source and that no dead custom utility classes remain in `styles.scss`,
So that Story 20.2 has a defined, executable contract to make pass when it wires the token system (P1 item #3 from Aspect 9 of the critical review).

## Acceptance Criteria

1. A spec asserts that `tailwind.config.js`'s `theme.extend` maps its theme values to the `--dms-*` custom properties defined in the SCSS — i.e., Tailwind utilities resolve from the same token source as Material SCSS, not from a parallel hardcoded set.
2. A spec asserts that no unused/dead custom utility class remains in `apps/dms-material/src/styles.scss` (every custom utility class defined there is referenced by at least one component or template).
3. All assertions in AC #1–#2 are marked `.skip()` (`it.skip`) so the dms-material Vitest suite runs green BEFORE Story 20.2 exists — red-phase by skip, not by failure. Existing passing tests remain unskipped and green.
4. The spec file(s) run green under `nx test dms-material` immediately after this story (new red-phase tests skipped), and Story 20.2's first task is to remove the `.skip()` markers, confirm they FAIL against current code, then implement until they pass.

## Tasks / Subtasks

- [ ] Task 1 (AC: #1): Add a Tailwind-token-source assertion.
  - [ ] 1.1 In a spec under `apps/dms-material/src/`, assert that `tailwind.config.js`'s `theme.extend` values reference the `--dms-*` custom properties (e.g., via `var(--dms-*)`) rather than duplicating hardcoded color/spacing values.
- [ ] Task 2 (AC: #2): Add a dead-class assertion for `styles.scss`.
  - [ ] 2.1 Assert that every custom utility class defined in `apps/dms-material/src/styles.scss` is referenced by at least one component or template — no orphaned/dead classes remain.
- [ ] Task 3 (AC: #3, #4): Mark red-phase assertions `.skip()` and confirm green.
  - [ ] 3.1 Apply `it.skip` to every assertion added in Tasks 1–2 — they are red until Story 20.2 wires the tokens + deletes dead classes. Leave all pre-existing tests unskipped.
  - [ ] 3.2 Run `nx test dms-material` and confirm fully green with only the new red-phase tests skipped. Do NOT weaken or delete any assertion to achieve this — skip markers only.

## Dev Notes

- **Why:** the `--dms-*` tokens are currently defined in the theme SCSS but Tailwind's `theme.extend` does not consume them as its source — two parallel theming systems exist. Wiring Tailwind to the same tokens ends the drift, and deleting dead utility classes in `styles.scss` removes unused code (P1 item #3 from Aspect 9).
- **Red-phase TDD:** this story is ordered before Story 20.2. Assertions are marked `it.skip` so CI stays green while the parallel systems still exist; Story 20.2's first task removes the skip markers, confirms red, then wires + deletes until green.
- **Do NOT modify production code or SCSS in this story** — test scaffold only. The wiring + deletion belongs to Story 20.2.
- Vitest is the workspace test framework; dms-material tests run via `nx test dms-material`.

### Project Structure Notes

- Create/modify: a spec under `apps/dms-material/src/` (add skipped Tailwind-token-source + dead-class assertions).
- No changes to production `.ts`, SCSS, or `tailwind.config.js` in this story.
